def transform(grid):
    """On rows/columns intersecting the 2x2 zero marker, keep only 2s."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    zeros = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 0]
    if len(zeros) != 4:
        raise ValueError("expected one 2x2 zero marker")
    rows = {r for r, _ in zeros}
    cols = {c for _, c in zeros}
    if len(rows) != 2 or len(cols) != 2 or any(grid[r][c] != 0 for r in rows for c in cols):
        raise ValueError("zero marker is not a solid 2x2 block")
    for r in range(len(grid)):
        for c in range(len(grid[r])):
            if (r in rows or c in cols) and grid[r][c] != 2:
                out[r][c] = 0
    return out
PY
